items.summary: Recommendation: reject the weapontester.com readiness proposal as written because the supplied evidence lacks site-specific outcome data and the report would not produce a production or financial decision. Route three bounded metadata-only task repairs to engineer for 0daynews.com, amputeenews.com, and eastcoastrappers.com. Preserve one read-only public inspection for weapontester.com to close the observable positioning and conversion-path evidence gap. No unsupported revenue, causal, production, credential, configuration, spending, schedule, or duplicate-telemetry work is authorized.
